manualFollowUps: Pages: set the repo variable VITE_ACADEMY_HOMEWORK_OS=true before merging, so the Academy build shows the Homework screen and the learner My mistakes screen. Platform publishes schood.online/courses and the Mini App homework card; both stay quiet until academy-learning is deployed (the card hides itself, the catalogue shows its error state).

Database: supabase db push --linked --include-all only from an isolated copy of the installed migrations plus 20261024105000_academy_course_listings.sql and 20261024110000_academy_homework_launch.sql, keeping the 9 pending payment migrations from #220 (20261010162000-20261010174000) excluded. Dry run first. The listings migration adds academy_course_listings (service role only), academy_course_completion() and academy_public_course_catalog(). The launch migration sets telegram_handin.enabled, premark.enabled and digest.enabled to true; billing.enforced stays false.

Secrets: supabase secrets set TELEGRAM_INTERNAL_SECRET= is not run (already set). supabase secrets set SITE_URL= is not run (code default https://schood.online). supabase secrets set ACADEMY_LEARNING_WORKER_SECRET= is not run (cron uses internal_runtime_secrets.academy_learning_secret).

Edge: supabase functions deploy academy-learning --project-ref bbjawctnqrufvnesdsel immediately after the migrations (adds miniapp_*, public_course*, course_listing_*, the bot_commands worker cycle and the shared hand-in save path). On the first handled bot update it adds /homework and /center to the @schoodstudentbot menu.
verification: select key, value from academy_learning_config shows telegram_handin, premark and digest true and billing.enforced false.
POST /functions/v1/academy-learning {"action":"public_courses"} returns 200 with a courses array (empty until a course is listed).
POST /functions/v1/academy-learning {"action":"miniapp_homework","initData":"bad"} returns 401; {"action":"worker"} without the secret returns 401.
https://schood.online/courses renders; https://academy.schood.online shows Homework in staff navigation.
A photo sent to @schoodstudentbot by a linked student with open homework is filed (receipt message) and appears in the Homework review queue.

rollback.pages: Unset VITE_ACADEMY_HOMEWORK_OS (or set false) and re-run Pages; Cloudflare Pages rollback of schood-platform for the catalogue and Mini App card.
rollback.migration: update academy_learning_config set value='false' where key in ('telegram_handin.enabled','premark.enabled','digest.enabled'); update academy_course_listings set status='hidden' where status='listed'. Tables can stay.
